repairs.feedback:
A reviewer checked it against the person's conditions and found these not met:
- C-001: The automation filters only on status 'new' and never checks source. The practice run logged Lou (source 'referral') and Ray (source 'event') alongside Pat (website), so non-website leads are routed too.
- C-003: Non-California leads with a missing companySize are excluded from the Priya branch (other_leads requires companySize lte 200, and the automation's own risk note says so). The practice run showed non-California leads going to Priya (Pat, Ray, Lou), but the missing-size gap is a real miss.
Fix the workflow so it meets them.

workflow.title: Route new website leads and log assignments
workflow.goal: Read leads. Keep only new leads whose source is 'website'. Assign California leads to Marcus. Assign non-California leads to Priya when companySize is 200 or fewer or missing. Also assign any lead with more than 200 employees to Priya, so a California lead over 200 gets two log rows. Append one lead-log row per assignment and verify each append independently.

assumptions: 'send to' means record the assignment in lead-log; no outbound e-mail or chat is sent.
California is identified by region equal to 'California' or 'CA' (case-insensitive).
Only leads with status 'new' and source 'website' (case-insensitive) are routed.
A lead over 200 employees in California gets two log rows: one for Marcus and one for Priya.
A non-California lead with missing companySize goes to Priya.
risks: Region values spelled differently (e.g. 'Calif.') will not match and will go to Priya.
Source values spelled differently (e.g. 'Website ' or 'web form') will not match and will not be routed.
A lead with a missing region is treated as non-California and goes to Priya.
successCriteria: Only new leads with source 'website' are routed.
Every routed website lead is logged to lead-log for the correct assignee.
Non-California leads with missing companySize are logged to Priya.
The lead-log rows written by this run pass the independent sheet audit for every append.
